name: Hammerhead
description: Struck and plucked physical modelling: marimba, vibraphone, xylophone and glockenspiel bars, kalimba tines, bells, glass, a steel pan, and plucked or hammered strings. A mallet model (hardness, strike position, impact click) excites an 8-mode resonator bank with a tuned resonator tube, or a waveguide string; decay, damping, mute and pedal, pitch drop, vibraphone motor, wooden body and room. 16 voices, 10 programs, cheap enough for chords on the MPC.
author: Groundswell
